meta.title: CPAMP manager
meta.description: Native adaptation of the CPAMP v1.14.10 management UI. Reuses the saved Host connection for monitoring, providers, accounts, OAuth, configuration and maintenance. Human write actions require confirmation; the Agent tool remains read-only. Third-party plugin pages open at the original CPAMP site. Restart Harness after upgrading.

title: Usage monitor
description: All traffic recorded by the upstream service, not only Harness. Costs use CPAMP model price configuration, not actual bills or balances; zero may indicate missing pricing.
connectionHelp: Use your CPAMP Manager Server address and CPAMP Admin Key, not a CPA Management Key or model API key. The Host tests the connection before saving. Credentials are never stored in browser storage.
keepKey: Leave blank to keep the saved key only when the server URL is unchanged.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnect CPAMP and delete the saved connection credentials?
emptyConnection: Connect your CPAMP Manager Server to view usage.
trendDescription: Request counts by interval; the table provides the same data.
noData: No records available for this time range.
unavailable: This service did not provide a summary for this range.
pageLimit: Up to 50 records per page. Paging uses a fixed time window; refresh to include newer requests.
partial: Historical coverage may be incomplete. Values reflect only the data available upstream.
coverageUnknown: Historical completeness has not been verified.
unsupported: This feature is not supported by this server/version. Full Mode may be required.
